meta.title: Audience statistics
meta.description: Traffic on the BlueGenji Esport website: visitors, pages read, time spent and when people visit.

header.title: BlueGenji Esport in figures
header.lead: Traffic on the association's website, measured without cookies or cross-site tracking, and shown as it is.

kpis.label: Key figures
kpis.visitorsHint: Sum of each day's unique visitors: someone who came on three days counts three times.

evolution.hintWeekly: Daily visitors summed and page views, week by week: someone who came on three days of a week counts three times.
evolution.hintMonthly: Daily visitors summed and page views, month by month: someone who came on three days of a month counts three times.

method.title: Method
items: Measured by the site itself: no cookie, no third-party tool, no link to an account.
A visitor is only recognised for one day: visitors of a week, a month or a year are the sum of each day's visitors.
Time counted is the time the page is shown in the foreground, sent in slices, each capped at {minutes} minutes.
Known bots and people who object to the measurement are not counted. Today's figures appear the next day.

No row of a breakdown (page, device, source, language, hour) describes fewer than {min} visitors from the same day: small numbers are grouped, and a group still too small takes in the next row. Each day's totals are given as they are.
